views.markdown: **DelayOTA Left (v1.0)** is the ultimate all-in-one native iOS Settings tool designed to track, manage, and install DelayOTA updates directly on your device without relying on external websites, PC tools, or complex setups. Never miss a DelayOTA signing window again!

screenshots.accessibilityText: DelayOTA Left iOS 27.0.1 Supported Hardware List

views.markdown:
### 🌐 Live Apple Catalog Sync (`gdmf.apple.com`)
Queries Apple's official Software Update catalog in real-time with offline caching and pull-to-refresh for accurate expiration dates and build numbers.

### ⚡ One-Tap Device Supervision Toggle
Toggle supervised mode on and off instantly directly in Settings. No computer, backups, or external apps required.

### 🎛️ Dynamic Pending Window Filter (7d | 15d | 30d | 45d | 60d | 90d)
Filter firmware versions by real-time pending countdowns. Tap `7d` to immediately view updates expiring within a week.

### 📲 Built-in Localhost Profile Server (100% Offline)
Installs DelayOTA profiles via an embedded local HTTP microserver (`localhost:8080`). No Safari redirects, dead links, or internet required for `.mobileconfig` install.

### 🌐 Real-Time Apple TSS Signing Status
Integrated with `api.ipsw.me` to check whether regular iTunes/IPSW signing is 🟢 OPEN or 🔴 CLOSED (DelayOTA Required).

### 📋 Active Installed Profiles Inspector
Detects active profiles and effective restriction delays (`enforcedSoftwareUpdateDelay`) with a direct shortcut to iOS Profile Settings.

### 🛡️ OTA Download Blocker & Storage Purger
Kill automatic background updates and purge corrupt/partial files from `/var/MobileSoftwareUpdate` in one tap.

### 🔔 Local Expiration Push Alerts
Get local push notifications 7 days and 24 hours before any window permanently closes.

### 🔍 Smart Search & Filtering
Filter by "Compatible With My iPhone", version chips (iOS 18+, iOS 17, Older), Beta seeds toggle, and live search.

- 🛡️ **Device Supervision Active**: Ensures device is in supervised state.
- 📋 **DelayOTA Profile Installed**: Confirms valid profile.
- 💾 **Storage Check**: Verifies ≥ 6.5 GB free space available.
- 🌐 **Apple Update Server**: Confirms `gdmf.apple.com` reachability.
- 🔋 **Battery & Power State**: Checks ≥ 50% or on AC charger.
- 🧹 **OTA Cache Cleanliness**: Verifies zero corrupt downloads.
- 🚀 **Direct Deep-Link**: One-tap shortcut to launch Software Update in Settings.
